name: carr-v3-source-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: carr-library/ci-v3-results/
          retention-days: 7

  installed-capacity:
    name: Installed capacity contracts / Windows
    runs-on: windows-2022
    # Keep the existing native and source job budgets independent of this new gate.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: carr-library
    env:
      PYTHONUTF8: '1'
      PYTHONUNBUFFERED: '1'
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: '1'
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: '1'
      DO_NOT_TRACK: '1'
      CARR_CAPACITY_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Preserve exact committed source bytes
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}
        run: |
          git config --global core.autocrlf false
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
          architecture: x64
      - name: Install exact application and capacity test dependencies
        id: install-runtime
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'ci-v3-capacity-results' | Out-Null
          $sourceCommit = (git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          if ($sourceCommit -cne $env:CARR_CAPACITY_HEAD) { throw 'Checkout differs from the exact event head.' }
          $sourceCommit | Set-Content 'ci-v3-capacity-results/tested-commit.txt'
          python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r packaging/windows-semantic-cp311.lock
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          python -m pip install --only-binary=:all: pytest==9.0.2 reportlab==4.4.9 openpyxl==3.1.5 et-xmlfile==2.0.0 'beautifulsoup4>=4.12,<5'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          python -m pip install --no-deps .
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          python -m pip check
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Require all installed import and backup capacity contracts
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install-runtime.outcome == 'success' }}
        env:
          PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD: '1'
          PYTEST_ADDOPTS: ''
        run: |
          Remove-Item Env:PYTHONPATH,Env:PYTEST_PLUGINS -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
          $capacitySuites = @(
            'tests/e2e/test_import_batch_cli.py',
            'tests/e2e/test_streamed_import_cli.py',
            'tests/e2e/test_streaming_import_pages.py',
            'tests/ingest/test_import_budget.py',
            'tests/ingest/test_import_budget_worker.py',
            'tests/ingest/test_import_scan_pages.py',
            'tests/ingest/test_import_session.py',
            'tests/storage/test_import_capacity_backup.py',
            'tests/ui/test_import_center.py',
            'tests/ui/test_import_resources.py',
            'tests/e2e/test_backup_resource_cli.py',
            'tests/storage/test_backup_budget.py',
            'tests/storage/test_backup_capacity.py',
            'tests/storage/test_backup_resource_roundtrip.py',
            'tests/storage/test_backup_sidecars.py',
            'tests/storage/test_studio_clip_inputs_backup.py',
            'tests/ui/test_backup_resource_actions.py'
          )
          $capacityContracts = @'
          import hashlib, importlib, importlib.metadata, importlib.util, json, os, pathlib, runpy, subprocess, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
          checkout = pathlib.Path.cwd().resolve()
          source = checkout / 'src' / 'carr_library'
          def checkout_head():
              value = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], check=True,
                  stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True, timeout=10).stdout.strip()
              assert value == os.environ['CARR_CAPACITY_HEAD']
              return value
          tested_commit = checkout_head()
          import carr_library
          installed = pathlib.Path(carr_library.__file__).resolve().parent
          assert sys.flags.isolated and installed != source and not installed.is_relative_to(checkout)
          assert installed.is_relative_to(pathlib.Path(sys.prefix).resolve())
          suites = sys.argv[1:]
          assert len(suites) == 17 and len(set(suites)) == 17
          test_bytes = {name: hashlib.sha256((checkout / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in suites}
          def inventory(directory):
              assert directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink()
              files = {}
              for path in sorted(directory.rglob('*.py')):
                  assert path.is_file() and not path.is_symlink()
                  files[path.relative_to(directory).as_posix()] = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
              assert files and '__init__.py' in files
              return files
          expected = inventory(source)
          assert inventory(installed) == expected
          owners = [dist for dist in importlib.metadata.distributions()
                    if (dist.metadata.get('Name') or '').lower().replace('_', '-') == 'universal-research-library']
          assert len(owners) == 1
          owner = owners[0]
          records = [row for row in owner.files or ()
                     if row.parts and row.parts[0] == 'carr_library' and row.suffix == '.py']
          record_names = [pathlib.Path(*row.parts[1:]).as_posix() for row in records]
          assert len(record_names) == len(set(record_names)) and set(record_names) == set(expected)
          assert all(pathlib.Path(owner.locate_file(row)).resolve() == installed / name
                     for row, name in zip(records, record_names))
          names = ["carr_library.__main__","carr_library.application","carr_library.backup_budget","carr_library.backup_compat","carr_library.backup_incremental","carr_library.backup_incremental_cli","carr_library.backup_options","carr_library.backup_report","carr_library.backup_sidecars","carr_library.ingest.batch_cli","carr_library.ingest.batch_pages","carr_library.ingest.batch_scan","carr_library.ingest.batches","carr_library.ingest.catalog_asset_copy","carr_library.ingest.resource_budget","carr_library.ingest.session","carr_library.ingest.streamed_ingest","carr_library.ingest.streamed_text","carr_library.ingest.worker","carr_library.library_backup","carr_library.pending_backup","carr_library.storage.revisions","carr_library.streamed_import_cli","carr_library.studio.backup_inputs","carr_library.ui.backup_actions","carr_library.ui.backup_incremental_dialog","carr_library.ui.backup_resources","carr_library.ui.desktop_app","carr_library.ui.import_center","carr_library.ui.import_resources"]
          def origins():
              values = {}
              for name in names:
                  spec = importlib.util.find_spec(name)
                  assert spec is not None and spec.origin
                  relative = pathlib.Path(*name.split('.')[1:]).with_suffix('.py')
                  path = pathlib.Path(spec.origin).resolve()
                  assert path == installed / relative
                  assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected[relative.as_posix()]
                  if name in sys.modules:
                      assert pathlib.Path(sys.modules[name].__file__).resolve() == path
                  values[name] = {'path': str(path), 'sha256': expected[relative.as_posix()]}
              return values
          before = origins()
          harness = checkout / 'scripts' / 'ci_check.py'
          harness_hash = hashlib.sha256(harness.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
          policy = runpy.run_path(str(harness))['PYTEST_CHILD']
          report = checkout / 'ci-v3-capacity-results' / 'installed-capacity-contracts.xml'
          sys.argv = ['-c', '-q', '-o', 'addopts=', '-o', 'pythonpath=', '-o', 'xfail_strict=true',
                      '--import-mode=importlib', '--junitxml', str(report), *suites]
          namespace = {'__name__': '__main__'}
          try:
              exec(compile(policy, '<existing-offline-pytest-policy>', 'exec'), namespace)
          except SystemExit as exc:
              status = exc.code
          else:
              raise AssertionError('The existing strict child policy did not return its verdict.')
          cases = list(ET.parse(report).iter('testcase'))
          assert status == 0 and cases and not namespace['policy'].seen
          assert all(not any(case.find(tag) is not None for tag in ('failure', 'error', 'skipped')) for case in cases)
          counts = {}
          for suite in suites:
              module = suite[len('tests/'):-3].replace('/', '.')
              counts[suite] = sum(('.' + module + '.') in ('.' + case.get('classname', '') + '.') for case in cases)
          assert all(counts.values()) and sum(counts.values()) == len(cases), counts
          assert checkout_head() == tested_commit
          assert origins() == before and inventory(source) == inventory(installed) == expected
          assert hashlib.sha256(harness.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == harness_hash
          assert {name: hashlib.sha256((checkout / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in suites} == test_bytes
          result = {'status': 'PASS', 'tested_commit': tested_commit,
                    'passed': len(cases), 'failed': 0, 'skipped': 0,
                    'selected_suites': counts, 'test_files': test_bytes, 'installed_origins': before,
                    'python_files': len(expected),
                    'package_inventory_sha256': hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest(),
                    'policy_source_sha256': harness_hash, 'nvda': 'NOT_RUN', 'acoustic_quality': 'NOT_RUN'}
          (checkout / 'ci-v3-capacity-results' / 'installed-capacity-contracts.json').write_text(
              json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
          print(json.dumps(result, sort_keys=True))
          '@
          python -I -B -X utf8 -c $capacityContracts @capacitySuites 2>&1 | Tee-Object 'ci-v3-capacity-results/installed-capacity-contracts.txt'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Keep capacity contract evidence only
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
        with:
          name: carr-v3-capacity-evidence-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: carr-library/ci-v3-capacity-results/
          retention-days: 7

hunks.before:
if: ${{ !cancelled() && steps.install.outcome == 'success' }}
        run: |
          $proof = @'
          import hashlib, json
          from pathlib import Path
          import carr_library
          source = Path('src/carr_library').resolve()

        run: |
          $proof = @'

          from pathlib import Path
          import carr_library
          source = Path('src/carr_library').resolve()

assert expected and expected == actual, ('Installed application inventory mismatch',
              sorted(set(expected) ^ set(actual)), [key for key in expected.keys() & actual.keys()
              if expected[key] != actual[key]])
          digest = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(expected, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).hexdigest()
          print(json.dumps(dict(status='PASS', module_origin=str(installed),
              python_modules=len(expected), source_inventory_sha256=digest)))
          '@
          $proof | python -I -B -X utf8 - | Tee-Object ci-component-results/application-source.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
